name: Maruti Interior Products Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1997, Maruti Interior Products Ltd manufactures Modular Kitchen & Wardrobe Storage Accessories
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company manufactures, sells, and exports modular kitchen storage systems, aluminum long wardrobe handles & profile handles. Their brand Everyday Kitchen is focused on economic range and the other brand Spitze by Everyday offers premium products.

cons: Debtor days have increased from 77.2 to 99.4 days.
